statusDetail: Complete atomic audit of the URL as delivered. The host returned an nginx HTTP 404 for the homepage and every discovered machine-readable route, so the delivered error template is the only available archetype.

paths.description: Requested root URL and its only delivered archetype: the nginx 404 error response. Candidate discovery checked links, manifest, /robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml; none exposed another route. Not covered: intended product/content, forms, account, checkout, or other templates because the server exposes none.

findings.summary: The requested homepage is unavailable, so the site exposes no purpose or primary action.
findings.evidence: Direct HTTP fetch, browser DOM, screenshot, HAR, and Lighthouse all show the root URL returns HTTP 404 with only “404 Not Found” and “nginx”.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the intended homepage at this hostname, return 200 for it, and expose a clear heading and primary action in semantic HTML.

findings.summary: The 404 state offers no explanation, navigation, retry, or route back to useful content.
findings.evidence: DOM and quality probes found zero links, controls, or landmarks; the screenshot shows only the status and server name.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded semantic 404 page with a concise explanation, a home link, useful destination links, and a retry/search action where appropriate.

findings.summary: The page omits the viewport meta tag and is rendered through a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport on a 360px device.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout capture reports hasViewportMeta=false and clientWidth=980; DOM and quality probes confirm no viewport meta element.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` and use fluid/intrinsic layout sizing.

findings.summary: The error surface remains hard-coded to the browser-default light palette under a dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Dark-preference and default screenshots are byte-identical (8,340 bytes), and the DOM reports no CSS or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `color-scheme: light dark` and define surface/text colors that adapt to `prefers-color-scheme` or `light-dark()`.

findings.summary: The response is not a sound modern HTML document.
findings.evidence: The quality probe reports no doctype, no stylesheet, and two obsolete `<center>` elements; charset is supplied only by the HTTP Content-Type.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit `<!doctype html>`, semantic structural elements, an early UTF-8 meta declaration, and CSS instead of obsolete `<center>` markup.

findings.summary: The URL has no indexable site content or descriptive metadata.
findings.evidence: The server returns 404; title is generic “404 Not Found”; there is no meta description. Discoverability reports renderedEmpty=true and only two content tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a successful content page and provide a unique descriptive title and meta description reflecting visible content.

findings.summary: Essential indexing endpoints and canonical signals are unavailable.
findings.evidence: The homepage, /robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml all return 404, and the DOM probe found no canonical URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Return 200 for the canonical homepage, add an accurate canonical link, and publish consistent robots.txt and sitemap.xml endpoints.

findings.summary: Most browser-enforced security policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence confirms HTTPS and HSTS, but reports no CSP, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy while retaining HSTS.

findings.summary: The English error message has no document language declaration.
findings.evidence: DOM, recon, and quality probes all report an empty html lang attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Set `<html lang="en">` (and `dir` where needed) on the error template and use logical CSS properties.

findings.summary: The error state lacks semantic landmarks and any keyboard-focusable recovery path.
findings.evidence: The quality probe found zero landmarks and zero interactive elements; the raw HTML uses only center, h1, and hr.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap content in `<main>`, include a descriptive heading and explanation, and add visibly focused native links/actions for recovery.
